reports.title: Kenya: How do cult leaders manipulate their followers?
reports.description:
The conviction of Kenyan pastor Paul Mackenzie over the deaths of 191 people in the Shakahola forest has raised difficult questions about religious influence, manipulation and accountability.
Mackenzie preached an extreme form of Christianity, persuading followers to abandon their families, jobs and access to education and healthcare. His instructions to starve themselves to death led to one of Kenya's worst mass tragedies.
But what makes people surrender their judgment to religious leaders? How do cult leaders establish control over their followers, and why is it so difficult to break away?#DWAfricaSocialMedia#DWAfricaLinkPodcast

reports.title: Kenyans welcome Shakahola cult massacre verdict
reports.description: Many Kenyans have welcomed the guilty verdict in the Shakahola Forest Massacre. Families of the more than 400 victims, most of whom have not yet been identified, say the ruling is an important step toward justice.#DWAfricaSocialMedia
